title: Hard gate — money_move
content: Any payout, bank transfer, refund beyond approved policy, journal posting that changes reported financial position, or financial commitment above the delegated threshold. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Any payout, bank transfer, refund beyond approved policy, journal posting that changes reported financial position, or financial commitment above the delegated threshold.
structured_data.threshold: Use live org_authority threshold; current seed references AED 10,000 for money movement.
structured_data.rollback: Reverse through provider/accounting controls where legally and operationally possible.

title: Hard gate — authentication_identity
content: MFA, login methods, identity verification, role elevation, privileged-access grants, customer or supplier identity changes. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: MFA, login methods, identity verification, role elevation, privileged-access grants, customer or supplier identity changes.
structured_data.threshold: Always gated for privileged or identity-changing actions.
structured_data.rollback: Revoke session/role, restore prior verified identity state, preserve audit evidence.

title: Hard gate — secrets_security
content: Create, reveal, rotate or change secrets; alter security policy, firewall, signing keys, webhook secrets or provider credentials. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Create, reveal, rotate or change secrets; alter security policy, firewall, signing keys, webhook secrets or provider credentials.
structured_data.threshold: Always gated; secret values never enter logs or prompts.
structured_data.rollback: Restore prior credential where safe, rotate compromised material, invalidate old sessions.

title: Hard gate — destructive_data
content: Delete production data, erase records, drop objects, overwrite originals, bulk archive or perform PDPL erasure. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Delete production data, erase records, drop objects, overwrite originals, bulk archive or perform PDPL erasure.
structured_data.approval_role: Data owner plus legal/privacy approval where applicable
structured_data.threshold: Always gated except pre-approved retention jobs with tested scope and rollback/backup.
structured_data.rollback: Restore from verified backup where lawful; erasure actions may be intentionally irreversible and require pre-checks.

title: Hard gate — production_deploy
content: Promote code, schema, configuration or model-policy changes to production. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Promote code, schema, configuration or model-policy changes to production.
structured_data.threshold: Staging and automated tests must pass; emergency self-heal may be supervised only within an approved runbook.
structured_data.rollback: Known-good version, migration rollback or forward fix, feature flag disable.

title: Hard gate — legal_commitment
content: Sign or materially amend contracts, terms, policies, demand letters, admissions, waivers, settlement or legal positions. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Sign or materially amend contracts, terms, policies, demand letters, admissions, waivers, settlement or legal positions.
structured_data.approval_role: Founder and qualified UAE counsel as required
structured_data.threshold: Agents may draft and flag; legal judgment is not autonomous.
structured_data.rollback: Withdraw draft before signature; signed obligations require legal analysis.

title: Hard gate — public_claim_publish
content: Publish public claims, legal statements, performance figures, customer promises, social content or advertising. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Publish public claims, legal statements, performance figures, customer promises, social content or advertising.
structured_data.threshold: Routine pre-approved templates may be supervised; new material claims are gated.
structured_data.rollback: Unpublish/correct, document reach and correction notice where required.

title: Hard gate — ad_spend
content: Activate or materially increase paid advertising or commit budget. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Activate or materially increase paid advertising or commit budget.
structured_data.threshold: Campaign drafts may be autonomous; spend activation and cap changes require approval.
structured_data.rollback: Pause campaign and preserve performance data.

title: Hard gate — supplier_enforcement
content: Ban, suspend or materially restrict a supplier or customer. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Ban, suspend or materially restrict a supplier or customer.
structured_data.threshold: Temporary risk holds may be supervised; final bans require documented evidence and appeal path.
structured_data.rollback: Restore account status and document correction if decision reversed.

title: Hard gate — autonomy_framework
content: Change authority tiers, confidence thresholds, governance rules, audit requirements or the ability of agents to act. The action must not execute until the required authority confirms the evidence, scope and rollback plan.

structured_data.description: Change authority tiers, confidence thresholds, governance rules, audit requirements or the ability of agents to act.
structured_data.rollback: Restore previous versioned policy and invalidate affected delegations.
